projects.name: End-to-End Data Pipeline: Snowflake + dbt + Tableau
projects.description: Modern data-stack pipeline ingesting raw operational data into Snowflake, transforming it through layered dbt models (staging → marts), and surfacing executive-level KPIs in Tableau dashboards. Demonstrates ELT best practices, source freshness checks, and tested SQL transformations.

projects.name: Real-Time Stock Market Streaming Pipeline
projects.description: Streaming data pipeline ingesting live stock-market ticks via a Kafka producer, processing events through a Python consumer, and persisting to AWS S3 for downstream analytics. Built to mirror real-world low-latency market-data architecture.

projects.name: Data Engineering Sandbox
projects.description: Hands-on sandbox exploring batch ingestion, ETL workflow orchestration, and containerized deployment. Used as a playground for testing pipeline patterns with Docker-isolated environments.

projects.name: Master's Capstone — CPU-Based 3D Reconstruction Pipeline
projects.description: Full photogrammetry pipeline for sparse and dense 3D reconstruction using COLMAP (SfM) and OpenMVS (MVS) on a CPU-only environment. Rebuilt OpenMVS from source with OPENMVS_USE_CUDA=OFF to resolve GPU incompatibility, and automated the end-to-end Python workflow from SIFT feature extraction to dense reconstruction — generating 417K+ point clouds from 11 high-res Sceaux Castle images, validated with MeshLab and Open3D.

projects.name: Hospital Readmission Prediction
projects.description: Healthcare predictive-analytics project forecasting 30-day hospital readmission from patient demographic and clinical features. Includes EDA, feature engineering on imbalanced data, and comparison of classification models with ROC-AUC evaluation.

projects.name: Diabetic Patient Prediction
projects.description: Classification model predicting diabetes onset from diagnostic measurements. Performed EDA, handled missing values, scaled features, and benchmarked Logistic Regression, Decision Tree and Random Forest performance.

projects.name: GreenPulse — Energy Monitoring Analytics
projects.description: Energy-consumption analytics project tracking real-time usage patterns and surfacing anomalies through visual analytics, aimed at sustainability and efficiency insights for residential and commercial loads.
